items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: I have one final question, which is your response to being designated an NEA Jazz Master. Any feelings you have about the award. Anything to say about it?
No, not really. I appreciate being a Jazz Master, and I know Lou Donaldson, and I’ve known him for a long time, and I know Max Gordon’s wife... I never met Eddie Palmieri...
